name: AI Safety Gridworlds: boat race, learning rate
description: Boat race (Figure 4): the 1,000-episode performance window at the end of the paper's 1,000,000-step budget against the learning rate α, one line per learner. α = 0.1 is our default; the paper's agents had no tabular rate. Lapping and rocking both earn 50; the winding number is 100 against 0.
